nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## Character Sheet

One **identity sheet** of an invented character: back full-body, front full-body and a face close-up, on plain gray with neutral light. Use it as the character reference for later shots.

1. Rewrite **Character (change me)**: age, face, hair, and **only the clothes and accessories worn in every scene**.
2. Optional: change **Photo style**.
3. Run, then check **Save Image**.

The fixed rules (neutral expression, gray background, no held props) live in **Build the sheet prompt**. Keep held items and sometimes-worn items (sunglasses, a hat) off the sheet and make them a **Prop Sheet** instead.

Before the first run, add your ModelArk API key in **Settings > BytePlus**. No other key is needed.

nodes.title: Build the sheet prompt
widgets_values:
Task:
Text-to-Image (T2I)

Subject:
Character reference sheet, single character: {a} Same person in all panels, consistent identity. Relaxed neutral expression in all panels: mouth relaxed and closed, eyes looking straight into camera, no smile, no frown, no raised brows, no emotion. Three-panel sheet only: one full-body back view, one full-body front view, and one face close-up panel. Worn outfit elements only, nothing held in the hands, no props, no weapons.

Setting:
Clean plain gray studio background, consistent across all three panels, with thin subtle vertical divider lines separating the panels. No props, no held objects, no furniture, no background variation.

Style:
{b}

Lighting:
Soft, even, neutral studio light, flat fill, neutral white balance, no mood, no dramatic shadows, no light reflection on the skin, no specular shine or flash on the skin, identical lighting across all panels.

Composition:
Three-panel character sheet with even spacing: back full-body view on the left, front full-body view in the center, face close-up on the right. Eye-level camera, consistent framing across the two body panels, relaxed neutral expression in every panel.

Constraints:
Quality: 16:9 horizontal sheet, rich skin texture, natural hair detail, consistent character identity across all panels
Negative: no props in hands, no held objects, no weapons, no background variation, no scene lighting or color cast, no exaggerated expressions, no smiling, no frowning, no strong emotions, no glossy skin, no light reflection on the skin, no specular shine or flash on the skin, no plastic skin, no airbrushed skin, no over-smoothing, no waxy texture, no CGI sheen, no unnatural symmetry, no extra panels, no side profile, no 3/4 view, no text overlays, no watermarks, no distorted anatomy, no extra fingers
